lessons.original_question: Can one-step witness/cardinality summaries be reused as dynamic state under composition?
lessons.original_claim_or_model: A correct one-step cardinality/static statistic is sufficient as a recursively executable carrier.
what_failed: One-step exact marginal/cardinality summaries can lose shared-middle identity needed for later composition.
minimal_witness_or_failure_evidence: Two middle states suffice: identical one-step counts/support after coarse collapse can produce composition {endpoint} versus empty depending on which exact middle state is shared.
what_survived: Static one-step statistics remain correct in their stated scope.
Exact witness/provenance, nonnegative path counts and Boolean support form distinct carriers with one-way forgetting.
unexpected_structure_revealed: Middle-incidence correlation is a concrete missing object controlling composition.
new_distinctions: Boolean support versus count versus provenance
new_negative_boundary: One-step cardinality equality does not imply finite-word composition exactness.
new_questions_generated: What is the weakest carrier that closes under a declared operation family?
When does a local statistic become a sufficient dynamic state for only a restricted future language?
what_should_NOT_be_inferred: Do not infer that cardinality statistics are useless.
Do not infer that every future language needs full provenance.
lessons.novelty_status: PROJECT-SPECIFIC TYPING/BOUNDARY; generic equitability/lumpability is prior mathematics

minimal_witness: two middle states with equal one-step summaries and different composite support

lessons.original_question: Does BRC/HashClash mining reveal a new generic search algorithm?
lessons.original_claim_or_model: The source mechanisms may support a novel standalone generic search algorithm or algebra.
what_failed: The generic-search novelty claim rooted substantially to automata/state memoization, backtracking, CEGAR, powerset/join semantics and Set Cover.
minimal_witness_or_failure_evidence: Prior-art reduction plus exact residual-basis optimization containing Set Cover blocked a generic novelty claim.
what_survived: Branch Signature Router as a control-interface concept.
Residual Join Certificates and exact support-semantic recoalescence.
Precision debt/distinction cover/adaptive acquisition/interface factorization as reusable project objects.
unexpected_structure_revealed: Semantic exactness certificates can be separated from optimization quality.
General hardness can coexist with exact structured fast paths.
new_distinctions: certificate validity versus heuristic search quality
new_negative_boundary: No standalone generic-search novelty claim is justified by the mined mechanisms alone.
new_questions_generated: Which structural subclasses admit exact cheap normalization despite general hardness?
How much acquisition/storage/rewind cost is needed to certify a residual future signature?
what_should_NOT_be_inferred: Do not infer that prior-art absorption makes the route valueless.
Do not infer that BRC has no project-specific interface residue.
lessons.novelty_status: GENERIC NOVELTY ABSORBED; PROJECT-SPECIFIC INTERFACE/CERTIFICATE RESIDUE SURVIVES

minimal_witness: generic novelty roots to standard search/automata/join/Set-Cover structures

lessons.original_question: Do p-th-power covariance and p-power-free refinement-kernel simplifications hold across collapse policies?
lessons.original_claim_or_model: Scaling/refinement can be reduced by simple p-power covariance or by stripping p-power factors from refinement.
what_failed: H4 p-power covariance fails for DOWN/UP/NEAREST/FARTHEST.
H6 p-power-free kernel reduction fails because p-power factors change root microphase.
minimal_witness_or_failure_evidence: H4 DOWN: p=2,a=2,n=3 gives S(12)=9 while 4*S(3)=4.
what_survived: Aligned refinement r=a^p yields freeze islands.
A microphase decomposition root_p(a^p n)=a root_p(n)+j with 0<=j<a.
unexpected_structure_revealed: The discarded p-power factor is not redundant; it creates a finite microphase coordinate.
new_negative_boundary: p-power-free kernel reduction is not valid in this model.
new_questions_generated: Can microphase be promoted to the minimal refinement coordinate for selected futures?
How do phase transitions change when exponent and precision schedules vary jointly?
what_should_NOT_be_inferred: Do not infer that scaling structure is absent.
Do not infer that every nonaligned refinement behaves the same.

broken_implication: strip p-power factor => same collapse dynamics

lessons.original_question: Is every funnel layer strictly subbinary?
lessons.original_claim_or_model: In the funnel regime, every layer has strict cardinality growth below the binary bound.
what_failed: Finite funnel windows can realize spacing two throughout one or more layers, so strict subbinary growth at every layer is false.
minimal_witness_or_failure_evidence: Exact Lean development preserves only card(next)<=2*card(current); local funnel intervals can attain the binary-sized one-step bound.
what_survived: Aligned/funnel/binary regime trichotomy after corrected hypotheses.
unexpected_structure_revealed: Layerwise extremality and long-run asymptotics are different questions.
new_distinctions: one-step upper bound versus strict every-layer growth
new_negative_boundary: strict subbinary every funnel layer is false.
new_questions_generated: What is the sharp asymptotic funnel growth exponent or density after layerwise strictness is killed?
How often can binary-sized funnel layers occur along one trajectory?
analogous_prior_failures: R025 universal phase laws killed before regime split
how_prior_failures_helped: R025 showed that exact phase coordinates should be retained rather than replacing a killed universal law by another global scalar.
what_should_NOT_be_inferred: Do not infer that the funnel regime has no subbinary asymptotic structure.
Do not replace an every-layer false claim with an unproved asymptotic claim.
lessons.novelty_status: EXACT NARROWING / NOT CANONICAL IN R032
lessons.confidence_evidence_grade: LEAN-CHECKED SOURCE RESULT CONSUMED AS HISTORICAL LESSON

lessons.original_question: Is there a unique intrinsic scalar retrospective credit with universal submodularity/supermodularity?
lessons.original_claim_or_model: Feature/probe/checkpoint credit can be represented by one order-independent scalar with universal diminishing/increasing returns.
what_failed: Marginal M/B debt credit is order dependent.
Universal submodularity and universal supermodularity fail.
One scalar does not preserve semantic, rewind and resource tradeoffs.
minimal_witness_or_failure_evidence: Three-state distinct-kernel witness gives feature A marginal 1 before B and 0 after B.
what_survived: Typed credit/cost vector and Pareto comparison.
unexpected_structure_revealed: Credit is naturally typed and path/order relative; scalarization requires an external objective or convention.
new_negative_boundary: No canonical order-independent scalar marginal in the general calculus.
No universal submodularity/supermodularity of debt gain.
new_questions_generated: Which objectives justify particular scalarizations of the typed profile?
Can phase-relative research policy itself be represented as a Pareto problem rather than a universal score?
how_prior_failures_helped: Earlier carrier and phase failures suggest keeping typed coordinates instead of forcing a universal scalar.
what_should_NOT_be_inferred: Do not infer that scalar summaries are never useful.
Do not infer that pair coverage, debt and cost are interchangeable coordinates.
